owners.scope: Desktop release Forge helper owns release-mode signing and notarization settings, build provenance helpers, and make-result validation.
Electron Forge configuration owns app metadata, bundle id, icon/resource wiring, maker inventory, lifecycle hook wiring, and entitlements if they are introduced.
Existing project persistence owners supply backup, recovery, migration, save, reopen, and compatibility semantics; release scripts only verify them.

support.reason: The only desktop 1.0 candidate; distribution remains fail-closed until every required receipt verifies.
No native x64 signed installer or install/launch evidence exists.
Forge maker configuration is not Windows build, signing, install, launch, upgrade, or uninstall evidence.
Forge maker configuration is not native deb/rpm install, launch, or uninstall evidence.
Desktop 1.0 uses manual signed-installer replacement and has no update feed or updater lifecycle.
Desktop 1.0 supports local fail-fast logs, recovery, and opt-in manual support bundles only.
Publication requires an explicit release approval and a scoped credential supplied out of band.
Desktop 1.0 is a direct GitHub download candidate and has no App Store packaging, entitlement review, upload, or receipt evidence.
The desktop application is not distributed as an npm package and no npm publish mutation is part of this release contract.
No Homebrew cask, tap, checksum update, or installation evidence is part of the desktop 1.0 contract.
Desktop candidate verification may package local runtime assets but must not create or mutate persistent Cloudflare deployment state.

operatorOnlyMutations.reason: Creating a release tag is a mutating operator action and must not occur during autonomous candidate construction.
Pushing a release tag is a remote mutation that requires explicit maintainer approval.
Creating the GitHub Release is separate from local candidate verification and requires explicit maintainer approval.
Uploading the DMG, manifest, or checksum mutates GitHub release state and requires explicit maintainer approval.
